question: In the evolved-gas FTIR of oil shale kerogen pyrolysis, at which absorption peaks does CO2 appear under air and under nitrogen?
expect: air: 670 and 2360 cm-1; nitrogen: 634 and 2315 cm-1 (Table 3)
rendered:
According to page 8 of the document, under air and nitrogen atmospheres, CO2 appears at the following absorption peaks:

- Under air: 670, 2360 cm^−1
- Under nitrogen: 634, 2315 cm^−1
